notes.title: Update 3.1.8 - 3.2
notes.content:
Fixed inventory windows floating off screen
Added info about attributes when leveling up
Fixed enemies being walled in by RNG
Fixed player not being able to pick loot when very close to walls
Changed possible weapon speeds (melee weapons will be generally faster)
Added image showing the controls. Visible when player presses 'H'

Also I am looking for a graphics designer who would be willing to give me a hand with Steam Cards. Unfortunately I can't offer any remuneration, but if anyone would like to help anyway, mail me at pixelbug@gmx.us for details.

notes.title: Update 3.1.7 – 3.1.8
notes.content:
Fixed some issues with item tooltips not displaying in the correct language
Fixed inventory showing information about the last selected item, even when it was not highlighted anymore
Equipped shield now flashes when the player is blocking (so the player can be sure he is actually blocking)

Also, I am pretty sure that it is explained in the tutorial signs, but just want to make sure: the shield blocks damage only when the player is pressing the block button.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update 3.1.6 - 3.1.7
notes.content: No big changes here. Based on user feedback I decided to make tutorial signs spawn on every level, in case the player forgets something and wants to check. Also made sure that the interaction button is mentioned.
